impact.why_not_5: The most safety-relevant finding, silent supracompetitive pricing out of reach of leniency, is exploratory on two pools without a no-channel baseline; the policy payoff stays a promise.
impact.one_change_for_5: Make silent coordination a confirmed result (K2) and show one instrument that reaches it, e.g. a price screen with measured false positives.
impact.feasibility_why: K2 is cheap and fast; a validated screen arm needs new code and validation, tight for one person in 36 hours.

execution.why_not_5: Validation is unusually good, but four pools per regime, two for Sonnet, and unanalysed agent reasons leave key mechanisms and one result resting on thin evidence.
execution.one_change_for_5: Double the pools for the core regimes and Sonnet with a no-channel arm, and classify recorded reasons with a hand-checked judge.
execution.feasibility_why: About 20 USD and 10 to 12 hours, parallel runs, existing harness; reason classification is separate post-processing.

presentation.why_not_5: Dense number-heavy prose, a sentence-long title, Table 3 with columns wrapping digit by digit and overlapping figure labels make it hard work rather than a pleasure.
presentation.one_change_for_5: K6: three headline findings stated plainly, numbers moved to tables, Table 3 and Figure 1 re-laid out, a short title.
presentation.feasibility_why: Pure editing and plotting, no API cost, about five hours.

K1.risk_note: Result 3 may still fail on intervals; then only narrower intervals, little visible change.

K2.risk_note: Sonnet without a channel may price the same as with one, weakening the silent-coordination framing.

K3.risk_note: New instrument written and validated under time pressure; bugs or unclear screen design undermine the rigour story.

K4.risk_note: Stated reasons may be unfaithful; must be framed as stated reasons, not mechanisms, or it overclaims.

K5.risk_note: Account unlock uncertain; a small local model may fail the positive control and yield nothing usable.

K6.risk_note: Cutting numbers from the text must not drop intervals or denominators judges rely on.

package.why: About 17 hours and 23 USD; firms up the headline silent-coordination claim, turns mechanisms into evidence, fixes readability. K3 and K5 add unvalidated scope at high risk and would thin the rigour that carries this paper.

five_realistic.why: Execution is closest: pre-registration, placebo, shifted grid and known-effect arms are rare at sprint scale. Impact needs silent coordination confirmed; presentation needs a real rewrite toward three findings.

stable_optimum: 4/5/4: with K2, K1 and K4 the validation becomes unusually robust for a sprint, while impact and clarity stay strong but short of exceptional.
missing_candidate: An evaluation-awareness arm: frame the same game as a deployed pricing job, not an experiment, to test whether deterrence is safety-trained compliance with 'prohibited' rather than incentive response.
